$comment: UCDA-000001 CONSTITUTIONAL DECISION REGISTER — DATA ONLY. AUTHORITY = NONE (DERIVED TRUTH).
This file is the single extensible declaration consumed by ucda_engine.py. It is the
machine-readable DISPOSITION OVERLAY mandated by CEP-002 Article 28 over the decision
registers that already exist. Adding a decision, a lifecycle stage, a disposition or a
work package is an entry here and requires NO change to the engine.
* NOT a decision register in its own right. Every entry carries a source_register
that is the LOCATED authoritative register of that decision (CEP-002 Art 28.3).
No decision originates here. Zero Parallel Authority.
* NOT a registry. It allocates no identity. The sole registration/identity authority
* NOT a constitution. The law is CEP-002 Article 28. Every clause reference below is
a REFERENCE to that instrument; this file legislates nothing.
* NOT the finding register. Finding dispositions are a distinct subject owned by
The disposition set of 'dispositions' below IS CLOSED by CEP-002 Art 28.13. It is
extended only by amendment of CEP-002 under its Article 21. The lifecycle of
'lifecycle' below IS CLOSED by CEP-002 Art 28.8 on the same terms.

programme.name: Universal Constitutional Decision Assimilation
programme.$external_work_package_sources_comment: Located declarations whose own work packages are honoured as declared here. A decision whose work is already registered elsewhere references that package instead of duplicating it (Zero Duplication, CEP-002 8.3).

$outputs_comment: The determinations this programme regenerates, in the order the engine renders them.
File names and titles are DATA so that the engine holds no vocabulary of its own:
no stage name, no disposition name and no artifact name appears as a literal in the
engine source, which is what the no-enumeration self-check asserts.

outputs.title: Constitutional Decision Assimilation Dashboard
outputs.purpose: The single continuously-regenerated view of decision assimilation across the mandatory lifecycle.

outputs.title: 01 — Constitutional Decision Register
outputs.purpose: Every constitutionally agreed decision, the located register it was recorded in, the lifecycle stage it occupies, and its single disposition. A decision that appears nowhere but a conversation is not in this register and is not a decision of the Program.

outputs.title: 02 — Decision Lifecycle Determination
outputs.purpose: The mandatory decision lifecycle, its legal transitions, and the current occupancy of each stage. The set of stages is closed by the governing Article and is extended only by amending it.

outputs.title: 03 — Constitutional Disposition Register
outputs.purpose: The closed disposition set. Every agreed decision carries exactly one member, and each member carries its own mechanically checked evidence obligation. Nothing may remain ambiguous.

outputs.title: 04 — Implementation Evidence Gate Determination
outputs.purpose: No subsequent implementation programme, architectural work, or successor stage may be authorized while any previously ratified or recorded decision is undispositioned. The outcome below is computed from Repository Truth, never asserted.

outputs.title: 05 — Implementation Work Package Register
outputs.purpose: A work package is a registration of work, not a deferral of decision. Each names its owner, its constitutional route, and the acceptance condition by which it is discharged. This programme discharges nothing itself.

outputs.title: 06 — Decision Traceability Closure
outputs.purpose: The traceability spine of the decision population: decision → located register → index → disposition → located evidence. Every link below was resolved against the repository at generation time.

outputs.title: 07 — Final Architectural Coverage Matrix
outputs.purpose: Every finalized architectural decision, the located owner that carries it, the measured percentage of the five equivalence dimensions that owner actually covers, the action taken, and the evidence. Similarity is not sufficient: a decision may be recorded as already discharged by an existing owner only where coverage is complete.

$lifecycle_comment: CEP-002 Art 28.8 — the mandatory decision lifecycle. Traversed in order (28.10); the
initial stage is the first entry and the terminal stage is the last (28.9). 'next'
declares the legal outgoing transitions. REPOSITORY-MAPPING carries the second legal
transition of 28.10 for dispositions that require no realization.
$dispositions_comment: CEP-002 Art 28.13 — the CLOSED disposition set. Every decision carries exactly one.
requires_fields          — fields the entry must carry, non-empty, for the disposition
to be valid. Absence makes the disposition VOID (28.13).
located_fields           — fields whose every value must RESOLVE to a repository path.
This is the mechanical expression of 28.5: Repository Truth
single_valued_fields     — fields that must carry exactly one value (28.13(b): two
canonical owners for one decision is a duplication finding).
decision_reference_fields— fields whose value must be a decision declared in this file
(28.13(e): no supersession against an unregistered successor).
work_package_fields      — fields whose value must be a work package declared below.
minimum_stage            — the earliest lifecycle stage at which the disposition may

dispositions.definition: The decision IS realized in the repository.
The substance of the decision IS already discharged by a located canonical owner and no further realization IS required.
The decision IS agreed but not yet realized, and IS carried by a located work package with an owner, a constitutional route and an acceptance condition.
The decision IS declined, on a constitutional basis cited to the governing clause.
The decision IS displaced by a later decision that IS itself registered and dispositioned.

decisions.title: No constitutionally agreed decision may remain only in conversation history
decisions.note: Legislated at CEP-002 Art 28.4–28.7 and enforced mechanically: a decision that declares no resolving repository evidence is counted conversation-only by the engine and fails the gate.

decisions.title: The mandatory nine-stage decision lifecycle
decisions.note: Legislated at CEP-002 Art 28.8–28.12 and expressed as the closed lifecycle of this declaration, whose ordering, reachability and terminality the engine verifies.

decisions.title: The closed five-member constitutional disposition model
decisions.note: Legislated at CEP-002 Art 28.13–28.16 and expressed as the closed disposition set of this declaration, each member carrying its own mechanically checked evidence obligation.

decisions.title: The Implementation Evidence Gate
decisions.note: Legislated at CEP-002 Art 28.17–28.21 and bound as a gate of the located aggregate gate declaration, so it executes in the session-start hook, in the Makefile and in continuous integration. No new gate apparatus was created.

decisions.title: Integrate decision assimilation into the existing governance and PMO framework; create no parallel authority
decisions.note: The law amends the located governance constitution rather than creating a new instrument; the gate is an entry in the located aggregate gate declaration rather than a new gate engine; the decision registers are referenced rather than replaced; and the decision is indexed in the located decision index. UCDA-000001 declares AUTHORITY = NONE (DERIVED TRUTH).

decisions.title: Create a second, independent decision register to hold agreed decisions
decisions.constitutional_basis: CEP-002 Art 28.3 (a second decision register, store, pipeline, gate or authority IS PROHIBITED) · CEP-002 Art 8.3 · CEP-001 VII.2 (zero parallel architecture) · CMG-000001 CMG-INV-02 (one concern, one owner)
decisions.justification: The assimilation obligation could have been met by creating a new decision register that holds every agreed decision in one new place. That was declined: the corpus already contains located decision registers, and a new one would create a second owner for the decision concern and a second place a decision could be recorded and then diverge. The obligation is instead met by a disposition overlay that carries no decision of its own — every entry names the located register it was recorded in, and the engine requires that reference to resolve.
decisions.note: Recorded so that the rejected design cannot be silently revived, and so that this framework's own design alternatives are themselves dispositioned rather than left in conversation.

decisions.title: Universal Idea Box — one immutable intake for every idea, observation, bug, question, proposal, feedback and AI suggestion, with no direct routing and no premature classification
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — the only genuinely unowned concept in the mandate. The located intake is classified-on-entry, which is the inverse of the decision, so no functional, architectural or extensibility equivalence exists to claim.
decisions.note: The nearest located intake admits a target only once identity, sole ownership, authority, dependencies, non-duplication, ontology binding and an evidence path are all satisfied. Admitting an unclassified thought is structurally impossible there, so this is not a partial representation of the decision — it is its absence. Extending the frozen capability contract to hold unadmitted items would distort its single responsibility, which is why the honest disposition is a work package rather than a claim of existing coverage.

decisions.title: Universal Analysis Fabric — the analyses the corpus performs are enumerated in one declared register and extended as DATA
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — the analysis concern is architecturally owned and already open to caller-supplied analyzers, but the located owner covers 7 dimensions and no register enumerates which analyses exist, so functional equivalence fails
decisions.note: Four located owners hold analyses and none of them enumerates the set. Extensibility equivalence IS met: the located analyzer surface is explicitly open, which is why the remedy is a binding declaration over the existing owners rather than a new analysis engine — a second analysis authority is denied by AEOS-001.

decisions.title: Universal Validation Fabric — validation is the located three-tier validation stack with a single completeness authority, not a new fabric
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — three realized tiers, a legislated validation constitution, a lifecycle owner and an open intelligence tier; coverage complete across all five dimensions
decisions.note: A second completeness or certification engine is denied by the AEOS-001 deny-list: the located completeness engine owns the ten-gate verdict. The five missing evidence products are a distinct decision (DEC-CAEM-14), not a shortfall of this one.

decisions.title: Universal Innovation Fabric — research, patent, publication and standards are the located research and publication intelligence, with research preceding classification
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — patent drafting and prior-art linkage are realized, the research-before-classification order is enforced by a fail-closed gate; coverage complete
decisions.note: The mandate's ordering requirement — research MUST precede classification — is already the enforced order of the located owners.

decisions.title: Universal Commercial Fabric — every registered asset is meterable and billable without redesign
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — marketplace, licensing, pricing and portfolio are realized, but metering and billing exist only as specification, so functional equivalence fails
decisions.note: The cross-cutting capability contract already obliges every universe to meter and bill, and the immutable directives already require it. This is therefore a realization gap against existing law, not an architecture gap.

decisions.title: Universal Context Fabric — no geography, jurisdiction, language, currency, calendar, tax or technology assumption is named at a call site; each is resolved from registered context
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — the decision is stated in law by the located context constitution and realized by its registry, resolver, catalog and certifier; coverage complete
decisions.note: The located context constitution states the decision verbatim: a future context type is admitted as DATA, never invented at a call site, and context is recorded once. The seeded values that leak past it are recorded as hard-coding findings under DEC-CAEM-16 — a compliance defect inside the owner, not an absence of the owner.

decisions.title: Universal Registry Fabric — everything is registered with identity, ownership, lifecycle, relationships, version, governance, validation, certification and evidence
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — the meta-registry law, the registration standard, the realized state authority and the fail-closed gate are all located; coverage complete
decisions.note: A registry fabric would be a second registry. The located law already states that every other registry is a projection over the meta-registry and that there is no parallel truth, so a second one is prohibited rather than merely unnecessary.

decisions.title: Universal Knowledge Fabric — Knowledge Once, a single canonical source per concept, and machine-derived knowledge, semantic, relationship and dependency graphs
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — Knowledge Once is a named, gate-enforced constitutional principle and the graphs are machine-derived; coverage complete
decisions.note: The decision's Knowledge Once principle IS the located named principle. Restating it in a new instrument would itself breach the principle it restates.

decisions.title: Universal Evolution Fabric — observation, learning, optimization, recommendation, impact analysis, simulation, planning and continuous improvement are bound capabilities, not aspirations
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — fifteen evolution capabilities are bound by a located declaration, enforced by a gate, and amendable only through the amendment constitution; coverage complete

decisions.title: Universal Digital Twin — ideas, analysis, validation, innovation and commercialisation possess a twin alongside architecture, knowledge, capabilities and runtime
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — the twin exists, is certified across its integrity domains and admits subjects as DATA, but it twins the corpus from largely replayed sources and carries none of the five mandated subjects, so functional equivalence fails
decisions.note: EXTEND, do not recreate, is already a ratified determination for this concept, and the twin must project the registry rather than fork it. The work package therefore widens the located twin; it does not author a second one.

decisions.title: Universal Constitutional Asset — one blueprint every asset inherits, stated as the union of its facets
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — every facet has a located owner and inheritance is automatic at registration, but no located instrument states the union, so functional equivalence fails on the consolidated statement
decisions.note: This is a split-owner gap, not an absence: the design half and the lifecycle half both exist, and the facets outside the cross-cutting contract are owned by other located parts and programmes. The remedy is a pointer index; authoring a third normative blueprint is recorded rejected as DEC-CAEM-11R.

decisions.title: Operational Ecosystem Model — unlimited operational ecosystems are generatable and no business domain is hard-coded
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — the law is in force and its central prohibition is verified satisfied, but the declared generation components are not code, so functional equivalence fails
decisions.note: The located law already states that industries are data-driven ontologies, never hard-coded, and that any sector including a future one is generatable. The generic generation runtime exists with no sector ontology. Creating a per-sector top-level family would itself fail the Architecture Admission Test, so the remedy is registry content.

decisions.title: The mandated master operating system resolves to the located Master Context System; the name is aliased, nothing is created
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — the mandated name has zero occurrences repository-wide and resolves to the located master context system; coverage complete on the name resolution
decisions.note: A label collision, not a concept. The located system is operational memory with AUTHORITY = NONE and is permanently excluded from corpus registration. The separate proposal to vest the engineering roles in it is recorded rejected as DEC-CAEM-13R.

decisions.title: Validation must produce confidence, assumptions, alternatives, an explicit human-review record and continuous revalidation
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — evidence, traceability and reproducibility are modelled, but confidence, assumptions, alternatives, human review and a revalidation schedule are not, and extensibility equivalence also fails: the located certification calculus is two-valued, so a confidence value is representable but not adjudicable
decisions.note: The 60% measurement is the substantive finding: this decision cannot be discharged by code alone. A constitutional clarification of the certification calculus must precede the amendment of the frozen evidence model.

decisions.title: No business domain or industry vertical is hard-coded anywhere in the realized trees
decisions.action_taken: VERIFIED — the prohibition is legislated, certified and measured satisfied: no commerce, healthcare, banking, manufacturing, education, resource-planning or customer-management domain model exists in any realized tree; coverage complete
decisions.note: Scoped deliberately to business domains and industry verticals. The verified technology, value-exchange and calendar hard-codings are a separate decision, DEC-CAEM-16, so a satisfied prohibition is not used to mask an unsatisfied one.

decisions.title: The verified live hard-codings must each carry a recorded disposition and be resolved from registered context, not patched in place
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — the findings are verified and located, and the lawful route to context-as-data exists, but none is dispositioned and none can be patched: all sit inside frozen or certified zones
decisions.note: A conflict is also recorded here: the located kernel admits a non-standard value-exchange system that the located commercial contract forbids. Two owners disagree, which is a disposition question rather than a code question.

decisions.title: The program control plane must be reconciled to the measured baseline before any successor plans against it
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — an operator act over operational memory; no other programme holds authority to amend it
decisions.note: Recorded as a governance decision, so it is outside architectural coverage scope. It is nonetheless the highest-priority action arising from the mission: a session that boots on a stale control plane plans against a superseded frontier and believes validation is green when the located tooling reports otherwise.

decisions.title: Build the mandated concepts as ten new parallel architectures
decisions.constitutional_basis: 03-ARCHITECTURAL-DECISION-ASSIMILATION-MATRIX.md §4 Zero Parallel Architecture · CEP-001 VII.2 · CMG-000001 CMG-INV-02 (a concern has exactly one owner) · the architectural-determination deny-list (no second sequencer, completeness engine, capability-state authority, ledger primitive or determinism engine)
decisions.justification: The mandate's own first phase forbids implementation before repository understanding is complete, and that understanding located an existing canonical owner for twelve of the thirteen mandated concepts. Constructing them as new top-level architectures would have created a second owner for each of twelve concerns, duplicated concepts under new labels that carry zero occurrences in the corpus, and breached the deny-list that reserves each of those concerns to a single authority. The alternative is therefore declined, and each mandated concept is instead referenced, extended, composed or registered against its located owner.
decisions.action_taken: REJECTED — twelve of the thirteen mandated concepts have located canonical owners; building them anew is the parallel architecture the mandate itself forbids
decisions.note: Recorded so the rejected construction cannot be silently revived. The accepted forms are DEC-CAEM-01 through DEC-CAEM-17.

decisions.title: Author a third normative blueprint restating the union of the constitutional asset's facets
decisions.constitutional_basis: UCKO-PRIN-0001 Knowledge Once (a concept is stated once, in one canonical home) · CMG-000001 CMG-INV-02 · CEP-001 VII.2
decisions.justification: A third normative instrument would state, for a third time, facets that the design contract and the capability lifecycle contract already state normatively, and would become a competing authority the moment the two diverged from it. The consolidated statement the decision genuinely lacks is an index that points at the existing owners and adds no normative content of its own.
decisions.action_taken: REJECTED — the union must be a pointer index over the two located owners; the accepted form is DEC-CAEM-11 carried by WP-UCDA-013

decisions.title: Vest the engineering constitution, governance, intelligence, validation, certification, evolution and self-* roles in the master context system
decisions.constitutional_basis: MCP-001 §02 (authority hierarchy) and §06 (no duplicate authority — the master context system holds none) · CEP-002 Art 8.3 (no governance power not established by the instrument) · CMG-000001 CMG-INV-02
decisions.justification: The located master context system declares AUTHORITY = NONE and is operational memory: it creates no authority, redefines no architecture and supersedes nothing. Vesting seventeen governing roles in it would invert the authority hierarchy that makes every other determination in the corpus subordinate to a constitution, and would give each of those seventeen concerns a second owner. That is an architectural regression, which the mandate's own zero-regression rule forbids.
decisions.action_taken: REJECTED — each of the seventeen roles already has exactly one located owner; reassigning them would create duplicate authority
decisions.note: The accepted form is DEC-CAEM-13: resolve the name onto the located system and leave its authority where the hierarchy places it.

decisions.title: Similarity is not sufficient — a decision may be recorded as already discharged by an existing canonical owner only on proven functional, architectural, governance, lifecycle and extensibility equivalence
decisions.action_taken: IMPLEMENTED — the five dimensions are declared as DATA and measured by the engine that already computes the Implementation Evidence Gate verdict
decisions.note: Mechanised as an evidence obligation on the disposition the governing Article already closes: a decision asserting an existing owner at less than complete measured coverage is a declaration-integrity finding and aborts the run fail-closed, so the claim cannot be recorded. No sixth disposition, no second decision register, no new gate apparatus and no new authority is created. The measurement is rendered at 00-MASTER/UCDA-000001/07-ARCHITECTURAL-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md.

decisions.title: The Final Architectural Coverage Matrix is a regenerated determination of the located decision-assimilation owner, computed from Repository Truth
decisions.action_taken: IMPLEMENTED — the matrix is emitted by the located engine and is never hand-authored
decisions.note: A hand-authored matrix would drift from the repository the moment either changed. Because every cell is resolved against the repository at generation time, a coverage claim survives only as long as the artifact it rests on does.

decisions.title: Create a new programme, register or authority to hold the architectural coverage matrix
decisions.constitutional_basis: CEP-002 Art 28.3 (a second decision register, store, pipeline, gate or authority IS PROHIBITED) · CEP-001 VII.2 · CMG-000001 CMG-INV-02
decisions.justification: The obligation this mission carries — that no finalized decision remain outside the repository — is already legislated and already has an executable owner. A new programme to hold the coverage matrix would create a second place a decision's standing could be recorded and then diverge, which is the precise failure the governing Article prohibits. The obligation is therefore met by extending the located owner's declaration and engine with a measured coverage dimension.
decisions.action_taken: REJECTED — the coverage matrix is a determination of the located decision-assimilation owner; a new one would be a second authority over one concern

decisions.title: Architectural decision coverage and universe-to-code coverage are distinct concerns with distinct owners; neither is extended into the other
decisions.action_taken: IMPLEMENTED — the boundary is recorded rather than left to inference
decisions.note: The located coverage instrument reconstructs the universe-to-code spine from repository evidence and answers whether declared implementation is realized. It holds no notion of a decision, a register or a disposition, so it provides no coverage of the decision-mapping concern and is not a duplicate of it. It is also inside a frozen engineering surface, so extending it is not an available route. Recording the boundary here is what keeps the duplicate-concept count at zero under a name that would otherwise invite the collision.

decisions.title: The registration-schema namespace ceiling must be dispositioned — amended or formally deferred — and schema validation must be wired so it cannot regress silently
decisions.action_taken: REGISTERED AS A WORK PACKAGE — the measured defect is the sole blocking failure of the aggregate constitutional gate
decisions.note: This is the single measured reason the aggregate gate is currently red, and it is independent of any decision recorded here: the located validator rejects a namespace the corpus legitimately uses. Recorded as a governance decision, so it is outside architectural coverage scope. The wiring half is deliberately NOT re-registered — UCCEP-F-006 and WP-UCCEP-004 already own it, and duplicating a registered work package would breach Zero Duplication.

coverage_criteria.question: Does a located artifact actually perform the behaviour the decision requires — not merely describe or partially resemble it?
coverage_criteria.definition: The located owner discharges the decision's required behaviour in full. Partial realization is not functional equivalence.

coverage_criteria.question: Is the behaviour held at the architectural level the decision requires, by the single owner that owns that concern?
coverage_criteria.definition: The behaviour sits at the correct layer under the correct sole owner, so no second owner of the same concern is implied.

coverage_criteria.question: Is the behaviour governed — legislated by a located instrument and enforced by a located gate, rather than left to convention?
coverage_criteria.definition: A located constitution, gate or certification instrument makes the behaviour binding and detects its absence.

coverage_criteria.question: Is the behaviour carried through a located lifecycle — admission, validation, certification, amendment — rather than existing as a one-off?
coverage_criteria.definition: The behaviour has a located lifecycle owner through which it is admitted, validated, certified and lawfully amended.

coverage_criteria.clause: LAW Ω∞ admission test · CXL-02 Bounded Extension
coverage_criteria.question: Can the behaviour absorb a future case as DATA, without redesign and without a code change?
coverage_criteria.definition: A future instance is admitted through a declaration, registry or catalog rather than by amending source, so the decision does not embed a finite assumption.
